signals.title: -80% below its all-time high
signals.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -92%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
signals.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
signals.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

signals.title: SPX's MVRV 0.92 = 10th percentile of Bitcoin's history
signals.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.92 sits at the 10th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
signals.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 10th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
signals.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.
